[[Ether Seal]]s are magical inscriptions placed by [[Mursaat]] in key places like gates, narrow passages, crossings, etc., in order to keep away trespassers. When attached to a gate, the gate will only open when the seal is destroyed. They can also be found attached to a [[Mursaat tower]], in which case they will spread the [[Mursaat Tower (skill)|Mursaat Tower]] environment effect until they are destroyed.

==Notes==
*They are usually guarded by Mursaat or [[Jade construct]]s. Those without the Mursaat Tower effect are very easy to defeat by themselves.
*The [[target]]ing point for the seal is a few steps away from its visible sigil. The sigil will rotate around the target point to face its own target.
**The sigil design is shared with the one seen on Mursaat Tokens.
*They can be [[Knock down|knocked down]], which will [[interrupt]] and prevent their skill usage and [[attack]]ing.
*When attacking, they will [[wanding|spit]] balls of energy at [[longbow]] [[range]] at their target.
*They have a constant +10 [[health regeneration]] due to their monster effect [[Seal Regen]]. The tower Ether Seals can easily out-regenerate many "throw a few spells, retreat for energy" tactics.
*Ether Seals are stationary, so [[binding ritual]] [[spirit]]s that attack and/or [[character]]s using a [[flatbow]]/longbow outside of its casting range will not have a Ether Seal use its spells on them.
*The Ether Seal in [[Perdition Rock]] is affected by its own [[Mursaat Tower (skill)|tower debuff]] and so are the nearby [[Jade Bow]]s.
